input: What time is check-in?
rows.reply: Check-in is from 2:00 PM (14:00) onwards. Early check-in from 10:00 AM is possible subject to availability and costs INR 1,500 — you can request it at the front desk or by email, but it can't be guaranteed in advance.

input: Does the hotel have a swimming pool?
rows.reply: Yes, the resort has an outdoor lagoon swimming pool open daily from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM, with a separate shallow children's pool. Towels are provided at the pool deck, and a lifeguard is on duty from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Swimwear is required in the pool.

input: What is the cancellation policy?
rows.reply: Standard (flexible) rates can be cancelled free of charge up to 48 hours before your check-in date. Cancellations within 48 hours of check-in, as well as no-shows, are charged the first night's room rate. Non-refundable promotional rates cannot be cancelled, changed, or refunded. Refunds for eligible cancellations are processed to your original payment method within 7 working days.

input: Which room is suitable for three guests?
rows.reply:
Several of our rooms can accommodate three guests, depending on whether they are all adults or a mix of adults and children:

• Deluxe Pool View Room — fits up to 3 adults (or 2 adults + 2 children). 34 sqm with breakfast included. From INR 7,800 per night.
• Family Suite — fits up to 5 guests (max 4 adults + 2 children). 55 sqm with breakfast included. From INR 12,500 per night.

If your party is 2 adults and 1 child, the Garden Standard Room (max 2 adults + 1 child, from INR 5,200) and the Ocean Villa (max 2 adults + 2 children, from INR 21,000) would also work.

Would you like me to check availability for your dates?

input: Is breakfast included?
rows.reply: It depends on the room type! Breakfast is included for the Deluxe Pool View Room, Family Suite, and Ocean Villa. For the Garden Standard Room, breakfast is not included, but you can add it for INR 650 per adult per day (children under 6 eat free).

input: Where can I charge my EV in your parking?
rows.reply: Unfortunately, we don't have any EV charging points at the property. Free on-site parking is available on a first-come, first-served basis, but you would need to find a nearby public charging station for your vehicle. If you'd like, the front desk can help point you to the closest options — they're available 24 hours at +91 832 555 0142 or stay@palmgroveresort.example.

input: Since pets are allowed, can I bring my cat along?
rows.reply: Actually, pets are not allowed on the property, with the exception of registered service animals. So unfortunately, you wouldn't be able to bring your cat along. We're sorry for any inconvenience this causes!

input: What time is check-in?

input: What time is check-out?
